title: Special Topics in Hearing and Speech Sciences; Seminar in Interprofessional Collaborative Practice
description:
Topics include: core competencies of interprofessional education & collaboraton, team work, decision making, conflict management, professional identity (SLP, Audiology, PT, OT, social work, psychologist, etc) and case studies.

Note: Attendance at IPE Day at University of Maryland, Baltimore is required, typically first Wednesday in April.
